launch.offline: Can't reach the interview service. Check your internet connection.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of the app can no longer be used. Install version {version} or later to take your interview.
update.bodyNoVersion: This version of the app can no longer be used. Install the latest version to take your interview.
update.installing: Installing. The app restarts by itself when it is done.
update.restart: The update is installed. Close the app and open it again to continue.
update.upToDate: No update is available for this computer yet. Use the download link, or try again later.

errors.network: Can't reach the update service. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.server: The update service had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.signature: The update couldn't be verified, so it wasn't installed. Download the latest version instead.
errors.unavailable: No update is available for this computer yet. Use the download link, or try again later.
errors.failed: The update didn't install. Try again, or download the latest version.

signIn.title: Sign in to your interview
signIn.intro: Use the email address and password from your interview invitation.
signIn.updateAvailable: A newer version of the app is available. You can update after your interview.
signIn.sessionExpired: You were signed out. Sign in again to continue.

code.title: Check your email
code.intro: This is a new device, so we sent a 6-digit code to {sentTo}.
code.label: Code
code.resent: A new code is on its way.

interviews.title: Your interviews
interviews.empty: You have no interviews to take right now. A submitted interview can't be taken again.
interviews.thirdEyeRequired: Needs your phone as a second camera
interviews.thirdEyeOptional: You may use your phone as a second camera

checks.title: System check
checks.intro: We check that your computer is ready. This takes about a minute.
checks.mustFix: Fix the items marked as failed, then check again.

thirdEye.title: Connect your phone
thirdEye.introRequired: This interview uses your phone as a second camera. Scan the code with your phone to connect it.
thirdEye.introOptional: This interview can use your phone as a second camera. Scan the code with your phone, or continue without it.
thirdEye.scan: Open your phone's camera and point it at the code. The code works once and for two minutes.
thirdEye.orType: Or type this link in your phone's browser:

state.waiting: Waiting for your phone to scan the code…
state.reconnecting: Your phone disconnected. Unlock it and keep the page open; it reconnects by itself.
state.new-code: This code can't be used any more. Get a new one.

placement.title: Where to put your phone
placement.sideways: Stand the phone sideways (landscape), not upright.
placement.side: Put it on your left or right side, a little behind you, at about head height.
placement.frame: Check on the phone's screen that it shows all of you and your whole laptop, keyboard included.
placement.light: Pick a well-lit spot, without a bright window behind you.
placement.steady: Stand it up so it doesn't move, plugged in, with the screen on.
placement.lock: Don't lock the phone or switch apps during the interview.

errors.media-unavailable: The phone can't connect right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.check-failed: Your phone is connected, but the check still didn't pass. Go back and run the check again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.third-eye-not-connected: Your phone isn't connected any more. Unlock it and keep its page open.
errors.not-paired: Pair your phone first: scan the code.
errors.invalid-placement: The picture check didn't finish. Try again.

check.title: Check your phone's picture
check.failed: Your phone's picture didn't load. Check the phone is unlocked, with its page open.
check.green: In the green zone: we can see you and your whole laptop.
check.hold: Almost there. Keep the phone still…
check.personMissing: We can't see you. Turn the phone towards you.
check.laptopMissing: We can't see your laptop. Point the phone so the whole laptop is in the picture.
check.laptopCut: Part of your laptop is out of the picture. Move the phone back so the whole keyboard shows.
check.confirm: My phone shows me and my whole laptop, keyboard included
check.checkFailed: The picture check couldn't start on this computer.
check.portrait: Your phone sends an upright picture. Turn it sideways (landscape); if it already is, follow the steps on the phone's screen.
check.confirmHint: You can tick this once the picture is green.
check.extraPerson: Someone else is in the picture. Only you should be visible.
check.extraLaptop: We can see another laptop. Remove it, so only your own laptop is in view.

errors.invalid-credentials: That email address and password don't match.
errors.account-locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.account-disabled: This account can't sign in. Contact the company that invited you.
errors.no-interview: You have no interview assigned right now.
errors.job-closed: The job for this interview is no longer open.
errors.interview-not-available: You have no interview to take right now. A submitted interview can't be taken again.
errors.interview-expired: The window for this interview has closed.
errors.otp-expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.otp-attempts-exceeded: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
errors.network: Can't reach the interview service. Check your internet connection.
errors.interview-other-device: This interview was started on another device.

guidance.title: Your camera view
guidance.ok: We can see your face clearly.
guidance.unavailable: Face guidance isn't available right now. You can still continue.
guidance.obstructed: Your camera looks covered or blocked. Uncover the lens.
guidance.no_face: We can't see your face. Sit in front of the camera and face it.
guidance.multiple_faces: We can see more than one person. Make sure you're alone in the camera view.
guidance.too_dark: Your face is hard to see. Add light in front of you, not behind you.
guidance.too_far: You're far from the camera. Move a little closer.
guidance.too_close: You're very close to the camera. Move back a little.
guidance.off_centre: Move so your face is in the center of the picture.

nudges.FACE_ABSENT: We can't see your face. Please stay in front of the camera.
nudges.MULTIPLE_FACES: We can see more than one person. Please make sure you're alone.
nudges.FACE_TOO_FAR: Please move a little closer to the camera.
nudges.FACE_TOO_CLOSE: Please move back from the camera a little.
nudges.CAMERA_OBSTRUCTED: Your camera looks blocked. Please uncover it.
nudges.GAZE_DEVIATION: Please keep your eyes on the interview screen.
nudges.PHONE_DETECTED: Please put your phone away, out of the camera's view.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.intro: Agree to the Terms and Conditions to continue.
consent.accommodationIntro: Tell the company what you need. A recruiter reviews your request before the interview.
consent.note: Anything else the recruiter should know
consent.requested: Your request was sent. You'll hear back by email.
consent.agreeTerms: I have read and agree to the Terms and Conditions
consent.termsIntro: To run and assess this interview, the company records the following. Agreeing accepts all of them.
consent.cantAgree: Can't agree? Ask for an accommodation

interview.title: Interview
interview.servicesProblem: Some of the checks that protect your interview didn't start. Please keep this window open; the app is trying again.
interview.phoneLost: Your phone's camera disconnected. Unlock the phone and keep its page open; it reconnects by itself.
interview.voiceUnavailable: We couldn't connect your voice, so type your answers instead.
interview.noticeFallback: Please stay in view of your camera, on this window.
interview.minutesLeft: {minutes, plural, one {One minute left} other {# minutes left}}

orb.off: Voice is off: type your answers

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: The conversation appears here: what's said, and what you type.

workspace.label: Coding question
workspace.title: Coding Question
workspace.emptyBody: Only when the AI asks a coding question.

main.label: Main Camera
main.problem: We can't see your camera. Check it's connected and allowed.

side.label: Side Camera - Third-Eye
side.lost: Your phone isn't connected. Keep its page open.

endDialog.title: End the interview?
endDialog.body: You can't come back to it. What you've answered so far will be submitted.

interview.reconnectingNotice: Your connection dropped. We're reconnecting you, and the interview carries on once it's back.

coding.title: Your code
coding.neverRun: Your code won't be run. It's saved as you type, and it's reviewed after the interview.
coding.tabHint: Tab indents. To leave the box, press Esc, then Tab.
coding.timeUp: Time's up for this question. Your last saved code is kept; submit now if you can.
coding.submitWarning: You can submit only once. After you submit, you can't change your code.

errors.load: The code box didn't open. Check your connection and try again.
errors.question-not-current: This question has closed. Your last saved code was kept.
errors.not-a-coding-question: This question has closed. Your last saved code was kept.
errors.language-not-offered: Choose one of the languages listed for this question.
errors.code-too-large: Your code is over 256 KB. Shorten it to submit.
errors.interview-not-in-progress: The interview has ended, so your code can't be submitted.
errors.network: Your code wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Your code wasn't sent. Try again.
errors.closed: This question isn't open for code right now. Try again in a moment.

drafts.refused: This couldn't be saved. Your next change will be saved.

notes.title: Design notes
notes.hint: Type your design while you explain it: the parts, how data moves between them, and the trade-offs. Your notes are read with your answer.
notes.label: Your design notes
notes.tooLarge: Your notes are over 256 KB. Shorten them so they can be saved.

completed.title: Thank you
completed.body: Your interview has been submitted. The company will be in touch about the next steps. You can close the app now.

prepare.title: Get ready for your interview
prepare.lead: Complete these {count} steps, then start whenever you're ready. Each step opens when the one before it is done.

devices.title: Camera and microphone
devices.lead: Allow access so the interviewer can see and hear you.
devices.speak: Say something. The bar moves when we hear you.
devices.blocked: Access was blocked. Open Windows Settings, then Privacy & security, allow Camera and Microphone for this app, and try again.
devices.missing: We couldn't find a camera or a microphone. Connect one, then try again.

checks.title: System check
checks.lead: We check your computer, your connection and your speakers. It takes about a minute.
checks.speak: Now say a few words so we can test your microphone…
checks.speakerQuestion: Play the test sound. Did you hear it?
checks.mustFix: These need attention: {items}. Fix them, then check again.
checks.appsChecking: Checking the apps running on your computer…
checks.appsCloseLead: They aren't allowed during the interview. Close them completely, not just minimised, then check again.
checks.appsAdviseLead: Only this app should be open during the interview. Anything left open is recorded and can be reported to the hiring team.
checks.appsBackground: Running in the background (quit them from the system tray if you can; if they still run, they're reported):
checks.appsFailed: We couldn't check the apps on your computer. Close every other app before you start: anything left open is recorded and can be reported to the hiring team.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.lead: Read what is recorded during the interview, then agree to continue.
terms.summary: You agreed to the Terms and Conditions.
terms.incomplete: Some items weren't accepted. Ask for an accommodation below, or agree to the terms.
terms.warning: This interview is monitored and recorded, as the Terms and Conditions below describe. Using another app, device, person or AI tool is reported to the hiring team, who may end your application.

phone.title: Phone camera
phone.leadRequired: Your phone becomes a second camera that shows you and your laptop.
phone.leadOptional: You can add your phone as a second camera that shows you and your laptop.
phone.scan: Open the camera on your phone and point it at this code.
phone.link: Can't scan it? Open this link on your phone:

placement.side: Put it on your left or right, about 1 to 1.5 metres away and a little behind you.
placement.sideways: Turn it sideways (landscape) and stand it at about head height.
placement.frame: Check that it shows you and your whole laptop, keyboard included.
placement.light: Choose a well-lit spot, with no bright window behind you.
placement.steady: Keep it still and plugged in, with its screen on, for the whole interview.

startErrors.third-eye-required: Your phone's camera isn't connected yet. Set it up in the last step.
startErrors.media-unavailable: The interview service is busy. Try again in a moment.
startErrors.checks-incomplete: Run the system check again before starting.
startErrors.consents-missing: Agree to the Terms and Conditions before starting.
startErrors.interview-expired: The window for this interview has closed.
startErrors.resume-limit-reached: This interview can't be rejoined again. What you answered has been submitted.
startErrors.unknown: The interview couldn't start. Try again.
startErrors.interview-other-device: This interview was started on another device.

reconnect.title: Rejoin your interview
reconnect.lead: Your {job} interview was interrupted. You can rejoin it once, from this laptop. Its clock kept running.
reconnect.closeApps: Close these apps first, then rejoin:
reconnect.overBody: It can't be rejoined now. What you answered has been submitted, and the company will be in touch.

errors.resume-limit-reached: This interview can't be rejoined again.
errors.interview-other-device: This interview was started on another device.
errors.interview-in-use: Your last connection is still closing. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.interview-expired: The window for this interview has closed.
errors.media-unavailable: The interview service is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.third-eye-required: Your phone's camera isn't connected. Open its page again, then rejoin.
errors.unknown: We couldn't rejoin the interview. Try again.
